title: Finishing Arm Stroking
summary: Long, light passes connect the hand, forearm, and upper arm.
goal: Gradually reduce intensity and finish the arm massage.
startingPosition: The whole arm is relaxed and supported.
instructions: Continue over the upper arm while avoiding joints.
direction: From the hand upward along the arm.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
imageAlt: Educational diagram: finishing arm stroking, without text labels.
